items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Two (2) or more years of experience as a Medical Assistant in Women’s Health and/or Primary Care.
Experience in a large healthcare setting.
Experience with EPIC and Cadence module.

Under direct supervision of the clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers, the Medical Assistant performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within the Business and Professions Code of the State of California and the regulations of the Joint Commission of the Accreditation of Hospitals (TJC).

These duties also include, but are not limited to, clinical patient flow functions, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management, and cleaning/disinfecting the environment. This position requires knowledge of medical terminology, online scheduling, universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. Taking initiative, prioritizing demands, and working in a team environment are also essential to this role.

This position supports daily clinic operations, facilitates patient care, and ensures timely communication between patients and clinicians. Responsibilities will include managing patient messages and in-basket tasks, assisting clinicians with patient care needs, preparing for appointments, coordinating follow-up care, and maintaining efficient clinic workflows. Performs other related duties as assigned.
Knowledge and training in patient care, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management, and cleaning/disinfecting the environment.
Knowledge and understanding of FLOW process specific to UCSD community care.
Knowledge of online scheduling, universal precautions, and body mechanics.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, prioritize demands, and work in a team environment.
